claim: Sequence alignment across the activin class reveals conservation of the IAP motif in each ligand of the activin family, except for ActC and ActE.

claim: During complex formation between ActA:ActRIIB, the IAP motif forms the core of interactions with a series of hydrophobic residues in ActRIIB (Tyr60, Trp78, Phe101).
